text:
tara_partnerships: quick sync 1m HaloHSM (SI) wants a co-listing in the cloud marketplace pairing Redwood Private + their HSM-backed secrets service. core asks: SAML SSO example, SCIM provisioning sample, and KMIP HSM key-wrap demo. partner marketing needs an integration runbook + smoke script by EOW. @dmitri_eng @noor_security can you take a look?

dmitri_eng: I can own the smoke script. question: do they need on-path KMS calls from inside the Private VPC or an external KMIP endpoint?

tara_partnerships: HaloHSM prefers an external KMIP endpoint (they will host a preprod instance), but wants instructions for both proxy and direct flows. timeline is tight webinar next week.

noor_security: treat as BYOK for Private. include CA pinning, KMIP TLS thumbprint checks, and a short threat-model note about credential scope. do not include real certs in docs.

ashley_sales: HaloHSM will provide a dev tenant and a non-prod KMIP endpoint. they asked for a checklist to prepare service accounts, SCIM client credentials, and sample SAML metadata.

dmitri_eng: plan: 1) exchange SAML metadata (signed assertion sample), 2) SCIM token + incremental user/group sync, 3) KMIP wrap/unwrap handshake against their endpoint, 4) run Redwood rotate API to verify wrap/unwrap. i'll post sanitized commands.

dmitri_eng: SCIM token example:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://dev.halohsm.local/scim/token -d '{"client_id":"halo-dev","client_secret":"REDACTED"}'
```

dmitri_eng: rotate sample (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST https://private-api.staging.redwood-inference.local/v1/secrets/rotate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>' \
  -d '{"secret_id":"halo-demo","kms_key_id":"kmip://halo-key-01"}'
```

ci-bot: CI job #halo-integ-smoke finished 4 tests, 1 flaky (SCIM pagination). logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/alg/4242 :white_check_mark:

dmitri_eng: flaky caused by large group pages. switching to incremental sync with exponential backoff and idempotency header. will push updated script Tue.

noor_security: add idempotency header guidance, CA thumbprint validation step for KMIP TLS handshake, and a rollback procedure: revert to previous wrapping key + mark secrets read-only if rotation fails. also document short TTLs for provisioning tokens.

paul_pm: i can draft the runbook + a 3-slide webinar intro if eng supplies commands and 2 sanitized screenshots by Wed.

tara_partnerships: action items: Dmitri (E2E smoke + scripts) Tue EOD; Paul (runbook + slides) Wed EOD; Ashley (partner dev tenant & test certs) Wed AM; Noor (security blurb + threat-model & rollback) Wed EOD. marketing needs final assets Thu for rehearsal.

ashley_sales: i'll nudge HaloHSM for the test certs and service-account details today.

dmitri_eng: temp repo with scripts: https://git.internal/redwood/halo-integ (internal). will sanitize before external share.

noor_security: reminder do not store partner certs in public repos; use SecretsStore with limited access.

tara_partnerships: great. we'll consolidate and share a draft runbook tomorrow. thanks team :rocket:
